occurrences.englishText: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice.
Oh that my people would listen to me,
Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way,
Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things
But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
The sword will fall on their cities,
For the statutes of Omri are kept,
